---
title: "Dashboard"
pagetitle: "Dashboard · Space Syntax, decomposed"
page-layout: custom
title-block-banner: false
section-divs: false
toc: false
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <link rel="stylesheet" href="dashboard/vendor/maplibre-gl.css">
      <link rel="stylesheet" href="dashboard/dashboard.css">
      <script src="dashboard/vendor/maplibre-gl.js"></script>
      <script src="dashboard/app.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="dash">
  <div class="dash-side card">
    <div class="dash-brand">Explore the ladder</div>
    <p class="dash-hint">Pick a study area and a measure, or a ready-made comparison.</p>

    <label class="field"><span>Study area</span>
      <select id="dash-site" aria-label="Study area"></select></label>

    <div class="field"><span>View</span>
      <div class="seg" id="dash-mode" role="tablist" aria-label="View">
        <button role="tab" data-v="one" class="on">One measure</button>
        <button role="tab" data-v="compare">Compare</button>
      </div></div>

    <label class="field"><span>Quick comparison</span>
      <select id="dash-preset" aria-label="Quick comparison"></select></label>

    <label class="field"><span id="dash-a-label">Measure</span>
      <select id="dash-a" aria-label="Measure A"></select></label>

    <label class="field" id="dash-b-row" hidden><span>Measure B</span>
      <select id="dash-b" aria-label="Measure B"></select></label>

    <div class="field" id="dash-radius-row"><span>Radius</span>
      <div class="seg" id="dash-radius" role="tablist" aria-label="Radius"></div></div>

    <div class="field"><span>Zoom to</span>
      <div id="dash-windows" class="pills"></div></div>

    <label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="dash-base" checked><i></i><span>Basemap</span></label>

    <p class="dash-note">Values are percentile ranks among the study area's interior streets.
      Compare maps A minus B: red where A ranks a street higher, blue where B does, grey within
      10 points. Street data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).</p>
  </div>

  <div class="dash-main">
    <div id="dash-head" class="dash-head"></div>
    <div class="dash-mapwrap card">
      <div id="dash-map"></div>
      <div id="dash-legend" class="glass"></div>
      <div id="dash-tip"></div>
      <div id="dash-status" class="glass"><div class="spin"></div><span>Loading map data…</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="dash-right">
    <section class="card pad">
      <div class="card-title">A against B</div>
      <div id="dash-rho" class="big-stat"></div>
      <canvas id="dash-scatter" width="680" height="520" aria-label="Density of A against B percentiles"></canvas>
      <div class="axis-note">A percentile ↑ · B percentile →</div>
    </section>
    <section class="card pad">
      <div class="card-title">Agreement along the ladder</div>
      <div id="dash-agree"></div>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
```
